reproduction_logic: The intervention and control satisfy every current WP507 matching condition represented in CausalProbeArm: same probe_id and same nonbroadcast_input_sha256; intervention carries the exact broadcast; uptake precondition is held as observed; downstream output digests differ. Their intentionally different runner/model/config contexts exist outside the current arm schema and cannot participate in evaluate_causal_influence. Therefore current logic admits contract-scope causal influence. A hypothetical equality gate over one canonical execution-context digest changes only the confound-control dimension and returns UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL.

interpretation.observed: Current WP507 matched-control identity is insufficient to reject at least one class of execution-configuration confound that is invisible to the arm schema.
interpretation.not_observed: No historical F2 result was shown to be confounded; no real GWT/model execution occurred; no hidden-state causality claim was tested.
interpretation.root_cause: Matched causal arms commit to probe/input/output/broadcast/provenance strings but not to a canonical shared execution-context identity.

counterhypothesis_status.PROBE_ID_IMPLICITLY_IDENTIFIES_CONFIG: FALSIFIED_AT_FAIL_CLOSED_SCHEMA_SCOPE; arbitrary identical probe_id survives distinct external contexts
counterhypothesis_status.PROVENANCE_REFS_CAN_ENCODE_CONFIG: NOT_A_FAIL_CLOSED_GUARANTEE; identical generic refs can be supplied while contexts differ
counterhypothesis_status.WP510_DOWNSTREAM_CLOSURE_REMOVES_CONFOUN: NOT_SUPPORTED; output lineage closure does not compare intervention/control execution context

recommended_next_gate.objective: Compare two thin placements under equivalent deterministic fixtures: A) add matched_execution_context_sha256 directly to CausalProbeArm and enforce equality in evaluate_causal_influence; B) introduce one upstream typed ProbeExecutionContext/RunManifest object and require both arms to consume the same digest. Measure validation complexity, serialized bytes/hash work, duplication/drift risk and preservation of WP510 lineage semantics.
recommended_next_gate.do_not_promote: No E5 BUILD_CANDIDATE until one placement wins the ablation and all existing WP507/WP510 fail-closed tests remain preserved.
